lessons_used: Predictions were generally too high for optimistic forecasts, whereas zero or negative predictions significantly underpredicted positive wins.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) are helpful overall, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+5.4% and +4.3%), despite an initial loss (-3.9%).
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) generally worked, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+4.3% and +6.3%), though one test showed a strong negative result (-4.3%).
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across both of its tests.
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, choose_path redesign, finish layout, home hint, home new_flow, and sign_in redesign, as each has only one test.

lessons_next: Predictions were consistently too optimistic for high forecasts, whereas zero or negative predictions underpredicted major wins.
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) were generally helpful, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+4.6% and +6.6%), though one test performed worse (-4.6%).
Waiting screen info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across both of its tests.
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) produced inconsistent results, winning in 2 tests (+6.1% and +4.7%) while performing worse in 2 others (-4.4% and -9.3%).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout (1 win, 1 no clear effect) and all single-test categories, as at least 2 agreeing tests are needed to establish a pattern.
